import django
django.setup()
from django.db.models import Count, Q
from apps.catalog.models import OfferCandidate, ProductFamily, OfferFamilyPlacement, Offer
from apps.catalog.services.public_eligibility import public_eligibility_q
from django.utils import timezone
q=Offer.objects.filter(public_eligibility_q(timezone.now()))
pending=OfferCandidate.objects.filter(status=OfferCandidate.Status.PENDING)
print("PENDING_TOTAL",pending.count())
for f in ProductFamily.objects.all().order_by("display_order","slug"):
  n=pending.filter(product_family=f).count()
  public=OfferFamilyPlacement.objects.filter(product_family=f,offer__in=q).values("offer_id").distinct().count()
  print("FAMILY",f.slug,"STATUS",f.status,"PENDING",n,"ELIGIBLE_PLACEMENTS",public,"CAP20_HIT",n>=20)
print("RETIRED_PENDING",pending.filter(product_family__status=ProductFamily.Status.RETIRED).count())
print("LIVE_CATEGORIES",ProductFamily.objects.exclude(status=ProductFamily.Status.RETIRED).count())
print("ACTIVE_WITHOUT_ELIGIBLE",Offer.objects.filter(is_active=True).exclude(pk__in=q).count())
print("CATEGORY_DB_END")
PY
